voice.description: A young female archer and sharpshooter in her twenties: a cool, focused, slightly husky mezzo voice, precise and dry-humoured, quiet confidence, speaks low as if not to give away her position. She speaks English with a soft, neutral accent, close to the microphone in a quiet room, performing a character in a fantasy strategy game.
